concepts.prompt:
Create a realistic production-quality desktop app UI concept named Quiet Workspace, one coherent screen at 1440 x 1024. App content only: no wallpaper, device frame, presentation captions or concept numbers. Use the three attached PUBLIC reference images as grounding: Paseo's public product-demo page for workspace/session relationships and the official Codex light/dark images for restrained native typography, composer proportions and quiet chrome. Recompose, never paste their imagery. This is a new Paseo plugin experience, not a literal clone.
Product goal: supervise AI work across hosts, projects, isolated workspaces and durable sessions. Three orthogonal axes: client→server→runtime is execution location/observation; control→harness→model is responsibility/capability; project→workspace→session is organization. Communicate them through a compact scope strip and expandable context, not nine menus or a technical diagram.
Workspace-first, conversation-led. Near-white canvas, warm-neutral 230px sidebar, fine separators, minimal borders and almost no shadows. System sans 14–16px and monospace for code only. Blue for links/focus; semantic amber and green/red for attention/evidence. Readable text around 65 characters per line. No ornamental gradients, metrics dashboards, nested cards or one card per list row.
Synthetic English UI: sidebar Paseo, 'Needs attention 2', Projects with 'paseo-plugins' expanded; 'Control surface' selected and 'Reconnect handling' below; another project 'docs'. A subtle host picker 'Devbox · Connected'. Main breadcrumb 'paseo-plugins / control-surface', session title 'Make workspace reconnect reliable', quiet provenance 'Codex · GPT-6.1-Sol', branch 'feature/reconnect'. These are illustrative fixture labels.
Main conversation: user 'Keep the active session visible after reconnect.' Agent 'The reconnect view is ready to inspect.' Collapsed activity 'Edited 3 files · Ran 2 commands'. Separate evidence rows 'Unit tests — Passed' and 'App interaction — Not checked'. Status 'Turn ended', never task completed. The ONE primary action is 'Review changes'. A narrow secondary evidence pane lists three files and +42 −16 with a readable code excerpt, explicitly scoped 'Workspace changes'. No merge/publish/commit buttons. Secondary 'Open session' link.
Bottom rounded composer: 'Ask for a change…', an attached reconnect.ts chip, quiet actual configuration chips and send. Do not invent plugin Stop, Pause or Steer controls. Keep the conversation dominant and the sidebar/evidence pane secondary. Use spacing/grouping/alignment first, dividers second, tints third, necessary borders fourth, shadows last. Crisp correctly spelled text, no clipping. Anchor any dates to 2026-10-20; omit dates unless useful. This is an unimplemented concept using synthetic data.

Create one realistic production-quality desktop app UI concept named Attention Desk at 1440 x 1024. App content only, no device frame/wallpaper, app-on-a-card, presentation captions or concept numbers. Use the three attached PUBLIC images as visual grounding: Paseo's public product-demo page for workspace/session context, Codex official light/dark screenshots for restrained typography and quiet native-feeling controls. No screenshot collage.
The user returns to multiple AI sessions and needs to make one decision. Three orthogonal axes matter: client→server→runtime, control→harness→model, project→workspace→session. Express location, executor and belonging in a compact context strip, never a diagram or nine navigation layers.
Attention-first design: calm graphite dark UI with excellent text contrast, flat grouped surfaces, a precise blue selected/focus accent and small amber attention markers. System sans 14–16px and mono for paths only. No glowing effects, gradients, metrics/KPI cards, graphs, fake progress percentages or nested cards.
Synthetic English UI. Slim 210px rail: Paseo, 'Needs you' selected with count 2, Projects, History, bottom Settings. Active host scope 'Devbox · Connected'. Page heading 'Needs you', sentence 'Decisions that move work forward.' A single quiet summary '2 need input · 3 turns ended', where turn ended is not accepted/completed work.
Two-part inbox: 380px grouped row list and spacious selected-item detail. Selected row 'Reconnect behavior', 'paseo-plugins / control-surface', 'Input requested', '4 min'. Second row 'Review error handling', 'Turn ended'. Third 'Update documentation', 'Running', in a quieter section. Fine row dividers, no separate row cards.
Selected detail: 'Which state should remain visible after reconnect?' Breadcrumb shows project, workspace and session. Quiet provenance 'Devbox / Codex / GPT-6.1-Sol' uses illustrative fixture labels. Show a concise agent question, two plausible readable choices as text, a collapsible Recent activity row. Secondary context shows 'Workspace changes: 3 files' and 'Interaction check: Not run'. The ONE primary action is 'Open session to answer' to use real native controls; do not invent an API for generic question responses, Stop, Pause, Steer or approve-all. Ordinary questions and true permission requests are different.
At the lower edge show host-scoped 'Synced just now' and a quiet 'Other hosts' link: 'Local Mac — not connected'. Offline must never imply zero work or stopped runtime. Selected decision is the focal point, sidebar/list support it. Spacious alignment and 65-character reading measure. Use grouping and type first, separators second, tints third, borders only when necessary, almost no shadows. Correct crisp text, no clipping. Date anchor 2026-10-20, omit unnecessary dates. This is a concept, not implemented functionality.
